Question 11(b) [4 marks]: Describe how the operations of this business is interdependent with human resources.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Snowy Ice-Creams Pty Ltd is opening a new store in the city. They plan on purchasing machinery to make all products on site. They will be selling 30 different flavours of ice-cream varieties as well as several cake desserts.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Relates cause and effect of the interdependence between operations and HR
3 marks: Provides characteristics and features of the interdependence between operations and HR
2 marks: Sketches in general terms the interdependence between operations and HR
1 marks: Recognises and names interdependence between operations and HR

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Interdependence refers to the relationship between the core business functions, including the relationship between operations and HR. You need to relate cause and effect of operations on HR AND HR on operations. Operations managers inform human resources of the skills and experience they need workers to have. Human resources ensure that enough employees with the appropriate skills are available for the operations function and provide training if needed. The HR manager uses leadership style and rewards to ensure quality work is done by employees in the operations function.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Operations: informs the skills and experience needed for the role, job specification, number of employees required, training requirements. HR: provides the correct number of employees, sources employees with the correct skill set, provides training, any elements of the recruitment process.
